sub_tasks.desc: coder Agent: Develop CourseBrowse component: Render responsive grid of courses fetched via GET /api/courses with search/filter fields, client-side validation, CSRF token integration, OWASP XSS mitigation by sanitizing user-provided filter text, and tenant isolation by attaching authenticated tenant_id to API requests. API contract: GET /api/courses returns { courses: [{ id: string, title: string, description: string, tenant_id: string }] } with 200 status code or 401/403/500 errors.

coder Agent: Develop StudentCard component: Fetch student card data via GET /api/student-cards/{studentId}, compute and display remaining validity days using server-provided remaining_days, implement client-side validation for renewal input, secure API calls with JWT and tenant context, ensure PII protection. API contract: GET /api/student-cards/{studentId} returns { card_id: string, student_id: string, issue_date: string, expiry_date: string, remaining_days: number, tenant_id: string } with 200 status code or 401/403/404/500 errors.

doc Agent: Create technical documentation for CourseBrowse and StudentCard: Document component purpose, props, state management, API contract, security considerations including tenant isolation, CSRF usage, OWASP mitigations, and reference requirement tags and data dictionary entries ([DAT-003], [DAT-006]).

coder Agent: Develop EnrollmentForm component: Provide form for selecting course and submitting enrollment via POST /api/enrollments with required field validation, business rule enforcement against duplicate enrollments, CSRF token integration, JWT authentication, tenant context, and integration with CourseBrowse component. API contract: POST /api/enrollments payload { course_id: string, student_id: string } returns { enrollment_id: string, status: 'success'|'error', message?: string } with 201 status code or 400/401/403/409/500 errors.

coder Agent: Develop CardRenewal component: Offer UI for selecting renewal days (1-365) with input validation, initiate stubbed payment, call PUT /api/student-cards/{cardId}/renew with CSRF protection, update local card state, display confirmation notification, ensure tenant isolation and PII protection. API contract: PUT /api/student-cards/{cardId}/renew payload { renewal_days: number } returns { card_id: string, new_expiry_date: string, status: 'success'|'error' } with 200 status code or 400/401/403/404/500 errors.

doc Agent: Update technical documentation for EnrollmentForm and CardRenewal: Document component designs, API payloads, error handling, security notes including CSRF, input validation, tenant isolation, and reference data dictionaries ([DAT-004], [DAT-006]) and requirement tags.

tester Agent: End-to-end integration test for course browsing: Authenticate as Student ([ARC-004]), fetch courses via GET /api/courses, verify UI renders list, validate tenant isolation by checking only courses for authenticated tenant appear, assert OWASP XSS protections by ensuring filter input is properly escaped, confirm API response matches data dictionary ([DAT-003]) and requirements ([REQ-010], [REQ-007]).

tester Agent: End-to-end integration test for enrollment: Simulate student login, select course, submit enrollment via POST /api/enrollments, verify enrollment record creation in backend ([DAT-004]) and success notification, validate input sanitization and CSRF token handling, ensure duplicate enrollment is rejected per EXC-004.

tester Agent: End-to-end integration test for student card display: Authenticate Student, request card data via GET /api/student-cards/{studentId}, verify UI displays total validity, days used, and remaining days per [DAT-006], confirm PII is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and only necessary fields exposed (NFR-003), validate tenant isolation and GDPR compliance (NFR-008).

tester Agent: End-to-end integration test for card renewal: Login as Student, initiate renewal with valid days, mock payment success, verify backend updates StudentCards end date and logs action (NFR-006), confirm notification is queued for student (REQ-016), validate CSRF token and input validation (EXC-004).
